name: Langar wali Dal
steps: Rinse both dals and soak together in plenty of water for 8 hours in the refrigerator. Drain and put in a heavy saucepan with 1500 ml fresh water and turmeric.
Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered for 90–110 minutes, stirring often. Add hot water as needed; both dals must crush easily without a chalky centre.
Heat ghee, sizzle cumin and cook finely chopped onion for 8 minutes until golden. Add minced ginger and garlic for 1 minute, then chopped tomato, chilli powder and salt.
Cook the tomato mixture for 8–10 minutes until glossy. Stir it into the dal with the remaining 200 ml water; mash a little dal and simmer for 10 minutes until creamy.
Finish with garam masala and coriander. Keep the consistency gently flowing rather than stiff; serve hot, with rice or flatbread cooked separately.
passiveTime: Soak both dals for 8 hours in the refrigerator.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
